artifacts.name: babysit-pr
artifacts.description: Babysit a GitHub pull request after creation by continuously polling review comments, CI checks/workflow runs, and mergeability state until the PR is merged/closed or user help is required. Diagnose failures, retry likely flaky failures up to 3 times, auto-fix/push branch-related issues when appropriate, and keep watching open PRs so fresh review feedback is surfaced promptly. Use when the user asks Codex to monitor a PR, watch CI, handle review comments, or keep an eye on failures and feedback on an open PR.

artifacts.name: mr-zhou
artifacts.description: Convert a user-authorized leftover token budget or unattended work window into the highest-value finished artifacts available: build small projects, investigate repositories, produce cited research, create ethical monetization assets, improve tests and docs, or package an actionable backlog. Use only when the user explicitly invokes $mr-zhou or explicitly asks to consume a stated remaining token budget, use up a plan allowance, run a useful overnight token burn, or squeeze value from an expiring quota.
